scope: Kalimba Decay source voicing and native validation; installed Recon and packaged 1.4.0f1 unchanged.

audio_measurement.method: Hann-windowed fundamental amplitude in dry close output; 60 dB decay inferred from amplitude loss between two windows, without room, Bloom, Sympathetic or optional VOL. This measures the pitched ring, not total silence of a wet preset.

identity_comparison.cases: Three wooden models at .1/.5/1/4.05/8 nominal Decay and VOL 0/.5; Kalimba at .1/.5/1 and VOL0; note60 velocity.8.

Its Kalimba upper sample now uses full knob8; the2dB acceptance bound and wooden fixtures are unchanged. Original failed observations retained.
